title: Looking for a Language [Guest Diary], (Wed, Oct 21st)
description: This report is a guest diary entry analyzing web traffic logs collected by a SANS DShield honeypot over approximately three weeks. The analysis focuses on identifying anomalous HTTP requests by examining language preferences indicated in the Accept-Charset HTTP header, specifically noting requests that prefer the GBK character set used for Simplified Chinese. The author narrows down suspicious traffic by filtering on this header and observes a small set of requests originating from Beijing. The diary illustrates a methodical approach to data exploration using Elastic Kibana to find unusual patterns in large datasets, but does not describe a specific vulnerability or active exploit.
